#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int readInt() {
    int val = 0;
    bool negFlag = false;
    int ch;
    bool started = false;
    while ((ch = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (ch == '-') {
            started = true;
            negFlag = true;
            continue;
        }
        if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
            started = true;
            val = val * 10 + (ch - '0');
        } else if (started) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return negFlag ? -val : val;
}

long C[64][64];
int r, c;
long minDist = LLONG_MAX;
char seq[128];
int countA[128], countB[128];
map<long long, long long> memoMap;

void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long dist = llabs(x - y);
    if (minDist <= 1 || dist - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= minDist) return;
    if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
        if (dist < minDist) minDist = dist;
        return;
    }
    if (v1 > 0) {
        long long deltaX = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
        dfs(x, y + deltaX * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 > 0) {
        long long s1 = C[v1][r], deltaY = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
        dfs(x + s1 * deltaY, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
}

long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long key = x * 10000LL + v1 * 100 + v2;
    auto it = memoMap.find(key);
    if (it != memoMap.end()) return it->second;
    long long res = 0;
    long long d = llabs(x - y);
    if (d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > minDist) {
        memoMap[key] = res;
        return res;
    }
    if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
        memoMap[key] = 1;
        return 1;
    }
    char c = seq[v1 + v2 - 1];
    if (v1 > 0 && c != 'B') {
        long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
        res += solve(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 > 0 && c != 'A') {
        long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
        res += solve(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    memoMap[key] = res;
    return res;
}

void process() {
    r = readInt(); c = readInt(); getchar();
    fgets(seq, sizeof(seq), stdin);
    int len = (int)strlen(seq);
    if (seq[len - 1] == '\n') seq[len - 1] = '\0';

    int maxV = 2 * (r + c);
    for (int i = 0; i <= maxV; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= maxV; j++) {
            if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
            else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
            else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
        }
    }

    int v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c;
    long long x = 0, y = 0;
    while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
        if (x > y) {
            long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
            y += c1 * s2;
            v1--;
        } else {
            long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            x += s1 * c2;
            v2--;
        }
    }
    minDist = llabs(x - y);
    dfs(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
        countA[i + 1] = countA[i] + (seq[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        countB[i + 1] = countB[i] + (seq[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    long long answer = solve(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
    printf("%lld\n", answer);
}

int main() {
    process();
    return 0;
}
